Privacy

What you type stays in your browser. This site does not upload your puzzles.

There is no account, no sign-in, and no analytics. The site does not set tracking cookies, and it does not ask for your name, school, class, or a child’s answers.

When you use a tool, the only network requests are for the page itself, and, on the letter tools, for the word-list files. Those files are the same for every visitor. The request does not include the letters or puzzle you typed.

Share link on the Morse page puts the message after a # in the address. Browsers do not send that part to the server. Copy buttons use the copy feature on your device. Download buttons save a file on your device.

The letter tools, the cryptogram solver, and the crossword helper hide offensive words. That filtering happens in your browser after the word list has loaded. Maze and word-search pages are for making printed sheets. They do not ask for a name, a school, or anyone’s answers.

Feedback is an email link to alan.chang198807@gmail.com. A message you send by email is just an email. There is no form on this site.
